description: This Java source file defines the EnforcementFlow class, which converts changes in Things into write models by retrieving data and applying enforcement policies, utilizing caching and asynchronous processing with Akka Streams. It handles interactions with enforcer caches, retrieves Thing information via commands, and manages enforcement logic based on retrieved policies.

classes.name: EnforcementFlow
classes.description: A class that manages the conversion of Thing change events into write models by retrieving Thing data and applying enforcement policies using caching and asynchronous processing.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an EnforcementFlow instance configured with stream settings, actor references, dispatcher, and delete event flag.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream Flow that transforms maps of Thing IDs and metadata into sources of write models, retrieving Thing data and enforcement information asynchronously.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThingJsons
methods.description: Retrieves SudoRetrieveThing responses for a collection of Thing IDs, aggregating responses into a Map.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThing
methods.description: Sends a command to retrieve the full Thing data asynchronously, handling response and errors.

methods.name: computeWriteModel
methods.description: Generates a write model based on retrieved Thing data and enforcement cache entries, or produces delete models if needed.

methods.name: getEnforcer
methods.description: Retrieves an enforcement entry for a given Thing, either from ACL or policy ID, returning a cache source.

methods.name: readCachedEnforcer
methods.description: Reads the enforcer from cache for a specific policy, invalidating and retrying if the cache entry is out-of-date.
